subject: 现存东求堂
author: Reggaeman
source_note: 东求堂是慈照寺保存的室町时代建筑，与两层观音殿“银阁”分立。 图版只绘东求堂，不把银阁误作其立面。
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is the actual monument PHOTO and controls geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project black fine-contour STYLE sample; never transfer its Buddha subject. Draw the named Japanese building accurately as a complete, isolated elevation at nearly frontal view. Fine sparse black ink contours with a few structural lines; no broad dark fills, hatching, pencil grain or opaque silhouettes. Pure flat opaque WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, including every blank region inside and outside the subject. Center with generous margins. No shadow, gradient, texture, glow, checkerboard, color, text, labels, signage, people, foliage, surrounding buildings, watermark or frame. Subject: Jisho-ji Togudo, the ACTUAL 1485-86 surviving square Buddhist/residential pavilion at Ginkaku-ji, distinct from the two-storey Silver Pavilion. Preserve one-story hip-and-gable bark roof, white walls with dark timber grid, wood veranda and low elevation; remove the pine, tourists and signboard.
